name: clickflash-ecosystem
description: ClickFlash Photography Ecosystem - 6 apps for professional photographers

scripts.test:ci: pnpm run security:tracked-private-key-filenames && turbo run test lint typecheck
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently "pnpm run dev:master" "pnpm run dev:touch" "pnpm run dev:management" "pnpm run dev:mcp" --names "master,touch,management,mcp" --prefix-colors "blue,green,purple,yellow"
scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build:backend && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build:backend && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run build && pnpm --filter @clickflash/gallery run build && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-mcp run build && pnpm --filter @clickflash/docs run build
scripts.build:master: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-master run build:backend
scripts.build:touch: pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run build:backend
scripts.test:all: vitest run && node --test scripts/check-tracked-private-key-filenames.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro test && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer test
scripts.test:ecosystem: pnpm --filter clickflash-master test && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management test && pnpm --filter gallery-backend test && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch test
scripts.test:ecosystem:coverage: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run test:coverage && pnpm --filter gallery-backend run test:coverage && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run test:coverage
scripts.test:ecosystem:ci: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run test:ci && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run test:ci && pnpm --filter gallery-backend run test:ci && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run test:ci
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsc tests/ecosystem/reset.ts --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node tests/ecosystem/reset.js && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ecosystem.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:web: pnpm --filter gallery-backend run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run test:e2e && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run test:e2e
scripts.test:prod: npx tsc tests/ecosystem/reset.ts --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node tests/ecosystem/reset.js && npx playwright test --config=playwright.prod.config.ts
scripts.test:mobile: pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro run test && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer run test
scripts.test:e2e:full: bash scripts/boot-emulator.sh && concurrently "pnpm run test:e2e" "pnpm run test:mobile:e2e" --success first --kill-others
scripts.lint:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run lint && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run lint && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer run lint && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator run lint && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro run lint && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer run lint
scripts.lint:mobile: pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro run lint && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer run lint
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run typecheck:ci && pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run typecheck && pnpm --filter @clickflash/management run typecheck && pnpm --filter @clickflash/gallery run typecheck && pnpm --filter moneytrash-uploader run typecheck && pnpm --filter clickflash-installer run typecheck && pnpm --filter clickflash-license-generator run typecheck && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro run typecheck && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer run typecheck && pnpm --filter cloud-backend run typecheck && pnpm --filter clickflash-mcp run build
scripts.typecheck:mobile: pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-pro run typecheck && pnpm --filter @clickflash/mobile-consumer run typecheck
scripts.clean:all: pnpm --filter clickflash-master run clean 2>/dev/null; pnpm --filter clickflash-touch run clean 2>/dev/null; rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/node_modules/.cache
scripts.benchmark: npx tsx scripts/benchmark-ipc.ts && npx tsx scripts/benchmark-ai-scoring.ts && npx tsx scripts/benchmark-face-search.ts
